rules.name: cs-28-fx-group-legs-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, lower(cd.market_action) AS side, s.maturity_date AS value_date, cd.contract_number, cd.trade_id, cd.transaction_date, cd.original_lots::text AS original_lots_text, dt.premium::text AS price_text, cd.premium::text AS clone_price_text, cd.fixing_date, s.derivative_type FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd ON cd.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cd.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cd.security_id = s.security_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND is_latest_version = 1 AND premium IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trade_id) dt ON dt.trade_id = cd.trade_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(s.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND s.maturity_date IN (DATE '2027-06-23', DATE '2027-10-27') AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('GBS', 'SOR', 'ORM') ORDER BY client, value_date, cd.contract_number

expect.reason: 4 legs in each of the 4 groups
